 Welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Round 4 matches. 
 November 20, 2026 12:36 
 Update at 12:30 PM
 Kartik Chada picks up three as Punjab beats Tamil Nadu by five runs.
 Chandigarh failed to chase down UP’s 191-run target and lost by 30 runs in their clash, while Meghalaya beat Arunachal Pradesh by 35 runs.
 Elsewhere, Manish Pandey is trying to rescue Karnataka’s innings as it loses five wickets against Jharkhand, with 151 on the board after 17.4 overs.
 November 20, 2026 12:03 
 Update at 12:00 PM
 Tamil Nadu is in a spot of bother in its chase of 165 against Punjab, having lost six wickets, while Maharashtra, led by captain Ruturaj Gaikwad defeated Assam by four wickets.
 Elsewhere, Karnataka is reeling at 94/4 against defending champion Jharkhand, while Jammu and Kashmir is 120/4 batting first against Bihar.
 November 20, 2026 10:41 
 Latest update!
 Hyderabad vs Goa - Match abandoned without a ball bowled
 Services 57/3 (9) while chasing 135 vs Nagaland
 Arunachal Pradesh 66/4 (9) while chasing 180 vs Meghalaya
 Maharashtra 9/1 (1) while chasing 173 vs Assam
 UP 190/7 (20) vs Chandigarh
 November 20, 2026 09:47 
 Punjab stuttering against Tamil Nadu!
 Manimaran Siddharth has spun a web around the Punjab batters, the Northern heavyweights are 59/3 after eight overs, with Anmolpreet Singh and Ramandeep Singh at the crease. In-form batters Uday Saharan and Salil Arora are already back in the dugout.
 November 20, 2026 09:23

 A few matches have already begun. Here are the scores:

 Meghalaya 133/2 vs Arunachal Pradesh
 Assam 61/2 vs Maharashtra
 Uttar Pradesh 27/0 vs Chandigarh
 Punjab 21/3 vs Tamil Nadu
